correctness.rationale: Tensor identity A_H=A_G⊗J_2 has rank r over every field, even characteristic 2, so dim E²=r and quotient dimension c=2N-r. A nonzero ideal contains some square e_i²; multiplying by adjacent e_j propagates e_j² along every connected symmetric edge, proving E²⊆I. Conversely any subspace I⊇E² is an ideal because E·E⊆E². Counts equal 1+Σ_j [c j]_q, with lower bound q^(floor(N²/4)) from graph subspaces. Real adjacency eigenvalues of H are 2λ_i(G) plus N zeros, yielding h(H)≥h0²/(2d) via standard Cheeger inequalities. K4 blowup has h=3, rank_F5=4, c=4 and 1121 ideals; s_i=e_i0+e_i1 and t_i=e_i0-e_i1 form a natural basis over F5 with proper basic E². Independent computation directly enumerated 8-vertex Cheeger cuts, matrix rank, all Gaussian counts and cross-products of these natural basis vectors; finite tests corroborate the uniform proofs.
